subject: ddl: process temp global index correctly (#56608)
summary: Fixes ingest-mode add-index merge phase for partitioned tables with GLOBAL indexes by starting temp-index merge key ranges at the logical table ID (where global index keys/temporary keys are actually prefixed), and teaching `addTableIndex`/partition reorg iteration to handle `PhysicalTableID == tableID` as the “global index merge” step before (optionally) proceeding to per-partition merges for local indexes. Also fixes `PartitionedTable.GetPartition` to return a truly nil interface on missing partitions (preventing typed-nil surprises) and adds an ingest integration test covering global-index add with concurrent writes.
